Every product carries the manufacturer's factory warranty as published for that model — AMGO lifts are 5-year structural, 3-year hydraulic, 2-year electrical; Forward publishes its own structural and parts terms. Warranties are parts only; labor isn't covered. Contact us first and we open the claim with the manufacturer.

Because equipment ships by freight, returns are accepted for defective or incorrectly shipped items. Refused or returned shipments in good condition are subject to round-trip freight and a restocking fee. Ceiling, concrete, and power requirements are on every product page — confirm them before ordering, or ask us and we'll check.
